//: RELEASED Tekken 8 patches only — the per-patch authority scripts/patches.ts
derives windows from. Seasons stay authoritative in parse.ts's SEASONS const
(persisted to seasonBoundaries.json); patches NEST UNDER SEASONS BY RELEASE
DATE, never by version prefix.
Rules:
- Authored from the wavu.wiki Patches (Tekken 8) table, cross-checked against
Bandai Namco's patch-notes index. FOLD RULE (mechanical): X.YY.ZZ hotfix
releases collapse into X.YY — wavu lists each line's first public release
(often .01/.04), so a folded patch's start is its line's FIRST release date,
except a season opener which starts at the season boundary.
- Bandai skips numbers outright (2.07 was officially skipped 'due to the
release of the previous update data Ver.2.06.02') — NEVER invent a version
to fill a sequence gap.
- `start` ends at the next patch's start within the season / the season
boundary / open-ended for the newest (windows computed, never authored).
- `note` = community-facing hint (DLC character, headline feature), surfaced
in the filter dropdown.
Date notes: 2.00's wavu date is 2025-04-01 (Ver. 2.00.01), but the season
authority opens S2 on 2025-03-31 (deliberate UTC alignment) and the opening
patch starts at the season boundary — recorded here, not a TODO. 2.08.00 =
2025-12-01 (Miary Zo) confirmed on the full wavu table + Bandai's notes.
